title: When the ruler stops moving
summary: A sixty-benchmark study asks when leaderboards lose the power to distinguish frontier models, and what evaluation teams should do when tiny score gaps fall inside the ruler's own uncertainty. Then Google DeepMind's leadership handoff separates day-to-day model delivery from longer-horizon AGI and science work, while Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat leave to build a new research corporation.

threads.name: Where scientific AI research lives
threads.status: Demis Hassabis is handing day-to-day Google DeepMind operations to Koray Kavukcuoglu while becoming chair and Alphabet chief scientist and leaning further into Isomorphic Labs; Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat are leaving Google to form an independent public-benefit research corporation with Google as founding investor and Cloud partner.
threads.arc: The thread moves from specialist science teams dispersing into Gemini and Isomorphic to an explicit organizational split among the integrated frontier-model engine, a domain-specific drug-discovery company, and a new independent research vehicle still connected to Google by capital and infrastructure.

dives.story: When AI benchmarks lose the power to distinguish frontier models
dives.why_it_matters: Model-selection and evaluation teams need to know when small leaderboard gaps fall inside measurement uncertainty, because procurement and deployment choices should then move to representative workload tests rather than a famous benchmark's podium order.

dives.story: Google DeepMind's operational handoff and the departure of Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat
dives.why_it_matters: Researchers, builders, and organizations depending on frontier-lab science need to see where long-horizon research authority, product delivery, infrastructure knowledge, and public output land after one of AI's central institutions separates those responsibilities.

concepts_taught: benchmark saturation as loss of discriminative power: comparing the spread among top models with evaluation uncertainty, separating true task mastery from inadequate measurement resolution, and managing benchmarks through refresh, uncertainty reporting, revision, and retirement
